_comment: Chrome origin-trial registration for this deploy. The token is NOT a credential: it is an origin-bound public artifact, readable by anyone who loads the page, and it is committed on purpose so this deploy is reproducible from the repo alone. Delivered two ways for redundancy - the Origin-Trial response header in netlify.toml, and a <meta http-equiv="origin-trial"> in each HTML document.
trial_availability: Chrome 149 to 156; ends with the rollout of the next Chrome release, no later than 2026-11-17

verified.by: base64 decode of the token payload
verified.result: origin, feature and expiry all match; 56 days of margin
